mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_operation_audit_archive_batch() VALUES(#{batch.tenantId},#{batch.batchId},#{batch.resourceId},#{batch.factsFrom},#{batch.factsUntil},#{batch.rowCount}, #{batch.objectKey},#{batch.objectVersion},#{batch.sha256},#{batch.payloadBytes},#{batch.payload},#{batch.state}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE batch_id=mk_operation_audit_archive_batch.batch_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mk_operation_audit_archive_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND resource_id=#{resourceId} AND sha256=#{digest} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM mk_operation_audit_archive_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND batch_id=#{batchId}
mapper.update: UPDATE mk_operation_audit_archive_batch SET state='UPLOADED',object_version=#{version} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND batch_id=#{batchId} AND state='CLAIMED'
UPDATE mk_operation_audit_archive_batch SET state='VERIFIED',payload=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND batch_id=#{batchId} AND state='UPLOADED' AND object_version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT g.ticket_id,g.batch_id,g.expires_at FROM mk_operation_audit_archive_grant g JOIN mk_operation_audit_archive_batch b ON b.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND b.batch_id=g.batch_id WHERE g.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND g.ticket_id=#{ticket} AND g.actor_id=#{actor} AND g.revoked_at IS NULL AND g.expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND b.state IN('VERIFIED','ONLINE_PURGED') FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_operation_audit_archive_restored(tenant_id,ticket_id,batch_id,payload,expires_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{grant.ticketId},#{grant.batchId},#{payload},LEAST(#{grant.expiresAt},UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)+INTERVAL 7 DAY)) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE batch_id=incoming.batch_id,payload=incoming.payload,expires_at=incoming.expires_at
mapper.select: SELECT r.payload FROM mk_operation_audit_archive_restored r JOIN mk_operation_audit_archive_grant g ON g.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND g.ticket_id=r.ticket_id AND r.batch_id=g.batch_id JOIN mk_operation_audit_archive_batch b ON b.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND b.batch_id=g.batch_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.ticket_id=#{ticket} AND r.batch_id=#{batchId} AND g.actor_id=#{actor} AND g.revoked_at IS NULL AND LEAST(r.expires_at,g.expires_at)>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND b.state IN('VERIFIED','ONLINE_PURGED')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM mk_operation_audit_archive_restored WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND expires_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY expires_at,ticket_id LIMIT 200
